params.caption: 🎮 Ex-GTA 6 artist: Sony and Microsoft can't match Rockstar A former artist on GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption 2 says Sony and Microsoft can't compete with Rockstar, arguing the platform giants "do not care about making game products". The artist also called Rockstar's institutional knowledge "absolutely priceless". 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 21:00 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 👍 Agree or 👎 disagree? · 💬 Can anyone rival Rockstar? #GTA6 #Rockstar #GamingNews
